Expand-modal genie transition — the macOS-style liquid

UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

Viewport-space rect the genie field interpolates between.

(module scope)

One transition backend — frame draws the warp at eased funnel progress f after dt seconds; false reports a dead surface so the driver force-settles instead of latching.

frame

Draws one frame.

  • @param dt Frame delta seconds.
  • @param p Eased funnel progress 0..1 — 0 = the modal sheet, 1 = the
  • @returns False on a dead surface.

dispose

Releases every resource the backend owns (context refs, widget).

(module scope)

Live session record — stored on el._genie so close/destroy paths can cancel mid-flight.

raf

The pending rAF handle — cancel() stops the clock.

content

The veiled content element (visibility kept on bail-out).

renderer

The active renderer once the backend resolves (null while async-mounting).

p

Eased funnel progress — 0 = modal sheet, 1 = figure funnel.

last

rAF timestamp of the previous frame — dt source.

started

Session start (ms) — the GENIE_TIMING.MAX_MS watchdog.

done

Runs once on settle — open: none (unveil suffices); close: teardown.

cancelled

Set on cancel — the async backend pick short-circuits on it.

opening

True while opening (origin → modal); false on the collapse.

measured

Set once the first tick ran the measure+mount phase — the backend pick defers there so the rect reads land in a fresh task instead of interleaving with the caller's mount-task writes (forced-reflow governance).

cb

The rAF callback — allocated once per session and re-armed every frame (a per-frame () => tick(el, s) closure would allocate at 240Hz, violating the zero-allocation frame budget).

landed

Set once the converged terminal frame (media exactly on the destination rect) has painted — the next tick tears down. One composite cycle must elapse between the landing draw and the overlay removal or the funnel's last mid-flight frame pops straight to the page: the close-direction "blink".

GENIE_DPR_CAP

Overlay device-pixel cap — a fullscreen transition canvas at raw devicePixelRatio triples fill cost on dpr-3 phones; 2 keeps the warp crisp without exceeding the frame budget.

fallbackOrigin

Fallback origin when no figure resolves — a bottom-center dock sliver.

figureForUrl

Resolves the origin figure's element for deep-link opens: walks the page's media-figure elements in document order applying the same mediaSlugSeq numbering the build/deep-link used, and matches the slug trailing the URL. Returns null when no figure matches — the caller then falls back to the stored snapshot or the dock point.

  • @param el The element (its root scopes the query).
  • @returns The matching element, or null.

figureRectForUrl

The origin figure's live rect — the element resolved by figureForUrl, measured in viewport CSS px.

  • @param el The element.
  • @returns The figure's viewport rect, or null.

sheetRect

Resolves the sheet rect — the bounded modal card the warp's texture covers. The .expand-modal-media-figure element is the window: reference-faithful, the funnel carries the opaque card (media + frame) while the fullscreen glass veil and viewport chrome fade instead of warping — warping a fullscreen translucent slab read as a flat "mono block". Missing/zero-sized → the media item, then the content root, then a centered aspect-fitted rect so the field still has a valid target.

  • @param el The element.
  • @param content The modal content root (already resolved upstream).
  • @returns The sheet rect in viewport CSS px.

originRect

Resolves the origin rect — stored click snapshot first (it survives the page pin), then the live figure for deep-link opens, then the bottom-center dock point.

  • @param el The element.
  • @param preferLive True on close — re-measure so a resize while the
  • @returns The origin rect in viewport CSS px.

teardownOverlay

Removes the overlay + unveils the content — the settle/cancel teardown shared by every exit path. The renderer's dispose() removes its own canvas; the class sweep catches the dead clone the worker route can leave in the DOM slot after a failed transfer.

  • @param s The session.
  • @param el The element — shadow scope for the sweep.

tick

The funnel clock — raw = elapsed/duration mapped linearly: p = opening ? 1−raw : raw. No global easing — the reference is linear-time by design; the motion character lives entirely in the per-row staggered eases (x rows ease-in-out, y rows ease-in so the collapse accelerates into the card — the dock suck). The open runs the identical field in time-reverse so both directions share one liquid surface. dt is clamped to 50ms so a suspended tab resumes with a finite step instead of a lurch; MAX_MS force-settles so a wedged rAF can never latch the overlay. On settle the overlay drops and the content unveils in the same task, then done runs (open: no-op; close: the modal teardown).

  • @param el The element.
  • @param s The session.

startGenie

Starts a genie run: veils the content and arms the eased clock. Rect measurement, canvas creation and the backend pick (WebGPU widget when the opt-in layer is enabled and mounts, otherwise the universal 2D warp) all run inside the first tick frame — deferred so the transition's layout reads land in a fresh task instead of interleaving with the caller's mount-task writes (write → read → write → read is the forced-reflow pattern the governance gate forbids); it also means the warp always measures the modal in its fully-styled post-mount state.

Contract: returns false only when the transition cannot start at all (reduced motion, missing shadow/content) — the caller then runs its instant/CSS fallback. Once true is returned the session owns the outcome: a backend that dies before the first frame resolves to done (open: instant unveil; close: instant teardown) rather than latching.

  • @param el The element.
  • @param opening True for open (origin → modal), false for close.
  • @param done Settle callback — open: no-op; close: modal teardown.
  • @returns False when the transition cannot start — caller falls back.

measureAttach

The first-frame measure+mount phase — runs inside tick's rAF task where the transition's rect/dpr/viewport reads are the task's first reads. Measures the field, creates the overlay canvas, picks the backend and attaches it to the session.

  • @param el The element.
  • @param s The live session (opening flag carried on it).

attach

Attaches a resolved backend mid-flight — the spring has already progressed, so the warp picks up seamlessly. A dead/null backend resolves the run to done (instant unveil/teardown) rather than latching the overlay. Each backend owns its canvas and removes it inside dispose().

  • @param renderer The backend, or null when none could initialize.

makeCanvas

The overlay canvas factory — fullscreen, device-px capped, and already in the shadow (the worker route needs it in the DOM before transferToOffscreen).

canvas2d

The universal 2D backend — acquires the context and wraps the strip-warp renderer. Null when the canvas refuses a 2D context or the renderer construction throws — a hard throw here must never latch the veil, so construction is wrapped; on failure the canvas is dropped and the session resolves to done via attach(null).

startGenieOpen

Open transition — warps the media from the clicked figure's rect into the modal's media box.

  • @param el The element.
  • @param done Settle callback (the unveil already happened internally).
  • @returns False when the transition cannot start — caller falls back.

startGenieClose

Close transition — collapses the media from the modal box back into the origin figure.

  • @param el The element.
  • @param done Settle callback — the modal teardown (URL/dialog/scroll).
  • @returns False when the transition cannot start — caller falls back.

cancelGenie

Cancels a live session — the overlay drops and the content unveils immediately; done does NOT run (the caller keeps control).

  • @param el The element.
